class Sales::VerificationsController < ApplicationController
  include GaTrackable

  before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
  before_action :authorize_sales
  before_action :set_order
  before_action -> { check_form_stage(:verification_stage) }, only: [ :verification_stage, :verification_stage_submit ]
  before_action :ensure_order_belongs_to_current_user
  before_action :verify_order_status, only: [ :verification_stage_submit, :upload_mou, :resend_upload_documents_email ]

  # GET /portal/sales/orders/:id/verification_stage
  def verification_stage
    @expired = false
    if !@order.verification_expired_at? ||
        Time.now > @order.verification_expired_at ||
        @order.status == "cancelled"

      @order.cancel_order!(cancel_reason: "Verification expired")
      @expired = true
    end

    if session.delete(:track_send_data_msisdn)
      # Track successful MSISDN data submission
      track_sales_action("click_send_data",
                         order: @order,
                          custom_params: {
                            next_page_url: verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
                          })
    end

    # Track verification stage access
    track_sales_action("click_refresh_status",
                       order: @order,
                       custom_params: {
                         page_source: "msisdn_stage",
                         expired: @expired,
                         documents_uploaded: @order.all_required_documents_uploaded?
                       })

    render :verification_stage
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/verification_stage_submit
  def verification_stage_submit
    if !@order.verification_expired_at? ||
        Time.now > @order.verification_expired_at ||
        @order.status == "cancelled"
      @order.cancel_order!(cancel_reason: "Verification expired")
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Verification period has expired. Please contact the admin." and return
    end

    # Check if all required documents are attached
    unless Order::DOCUMENT_TYPES.all? { |doc_type| @order.send(doc_type).attached? }
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
                  alert: "The customer must upload all required documents before proceeding to the next step" and return
    end

    # Check if all documents have been approved by the verificator
    unless @order.all_documents_approved?
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
                  alert: "All documents must be approved by the verificator before proceeding to the next step" and return
    end

    redirect_to payment_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully moved to payment stage"
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/upload_mou
  # Handles the upload of MoU document
  def upload_mou
    begin
      if params[:mou_document].present?
        # Validate file type and size
        unless valid_document?(params[:mou_document])
          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Invalid document format or size. Please upload a JPEG, PDF, DOC, or DOCX file under 10MB."
          return
        end

        @order.mou.attach(params[:mou_document])

        if @order.mou.attached?
          # Find or create document approval for MoU and set status to pending
          document_approval = @order.document_approvals.find_or_initialize_by(document_type: "mou")
          document_approval.status = :pending
          document_approval.note = nil
          document_approval.reviewed_by = nil
          document_approval.save!

          VerificatorMailer.reminder_mou_uploaded(@order).deliver_later

          # Track MoU upload success
          track_sales_action("click_upload_mou",
                             order: @order,
                             custom_params: {
                               page_source: "verification_stage",
                               document_type: "mou",
                               upload_success: true
                             })

          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "The MoU document has been successfully uploaded."
        else
          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to upload the MoU document."
        end
      else
        # If no MoU document is provided, just redirect back without error
        # This handles cases where MoU is already uploaded and form is submitted
        redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
      end
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error uploading MoU document for order ##{@order.id}: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to upload MoU document: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/resend_upload_documents_email
  # Resends the upload documents reminder email with rate limiting
  def resend_upload_documents_email
    Rails.logger.debug("Entering resend_upload_documents_email method for order ##{@order.id}")

    # Rate limit email sending to prevent abuse
    if @order.last_resend_upload_email_at? && @order.last_resend_upload_email_at > 10.minutes.ago
      Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit hit: last email sent at #{@order.last_resend_upload_email_at}")
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You can only resend the email every 10 minutes."
      return
    end

    Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit check passed")
    begin
      Rails.logger.info("Sending reminder upload documents email for order ##{@order.id}")
      SalesMailer.reminder_upload_documents(@order).deliver_later
      @order.update(last_resend_upload_email_at: Time.current)

      # Track email resend action
      track_sales_action("click_resend_email",
                         order: @order,
                         custom_params: {
                           page_source: "verification_stage",
                           email_type: "reminder_upload_documents"
                         })

      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Email successfully resent."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error sending reminder upload documents email: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to send email: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/reorder_verification
  def reorder_verification
    begin
      @order.reorder!

      # Track order retry action
      track_sales_action("click_retry_order",
                         order: @order,
                         custom_params: {
                           page_source: "verification_stage",
                           retry_reason: "verification_reorder"
                         })

      redirect_to msisdn_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        notice: "Order has been successfully recreated. Please complete the ICCID selection."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error reordering verification for order ##{@order.id}: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        alert: "Failed to reorder: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def set_order
    @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
    unless @order
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "Order not found."
    end
  end

  def ensure_order_belongs_to_current_user
    unless current_portal_user.has_role?(:admin) || @order.sales_id == current_portal_user.id # ! TODO : USE PUNDIT
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "You are not authorized to access this order."
    end
  end

  def verify_order_status
    if @order.complete?
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "This order is already complete and cannot be modified."
    end
  end

  def valid_document?(document)
    content_type = document.content_type
    size = document.size

    valid_types = [ "application/pdf", "image/jpeg", "image/jpg" ]
    max_size = 10.megabytes

    valid_types.include?(content_type) && size <= max_size
  end
end
